description: This point dataset gives the name, code, address, type, ownership, location and Unique Property Reference Number (UPRN) of every current NHS hospital in Scotland. The data are supplied by Public Health Scotland and turned into a GIS layer from its coordinates, published on the Improvement Service's Spatial Hub and listed on data.gov.uk through the Scottish spatial data catalogue; the entry was last modified on 29 August 2024. Coverage is all current NHS hospitals in Scotland. Access: the Spatial Hub dataset page, with NHS inform's service directory for service details. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): OGL-UK-3.0. Free. Caveats: hospitals only, without capacity or services, and the listing may lag openings and closures. Simulation uses: hospital locations for hazard exposure, accessibility and emergency response planning; the UPRN links hospitals to building and address data. Related records: GP Practices - Scotland, the NHS England hospital estates statistics and healthsites.io.
